entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Working game title
entries.description: $POTIFY: A Wonderful High Life; short universe label POTIFY City, with title treatment of A Wonderful High Life.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Central genre
entries.description: Original cozy 3D farming/life simulator rooted in early-2000s GameCube-era pacing and controls, set in a fictional cannabis-growing city.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Inspirational lineage
entries.description: Emulate the feeling of Harvest Moon: A Wonderful Life and some Animal Crossing social exploration; do not reproduce copyrighted code, maps, layouts, characters, music or art assets.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: The city is the farm
entries.description: Small grow plot or rooftop greenhouse at first; a living neighborhood and progressively larger property replace the traditional inherited farm.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Daily life first
entries.description: In-world movement, chores, seasons, conversation, shopping, sleeping and meaningful passage of time drive gameplay.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Grow–harvest–sell–upgrade
entries.description: The repeatable backbone of the game: acquire fictional genetics and supplies, care for virtual plants, harvest, sell, expand.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Seed → Soil → Solana
entries.description: Canonical POTIFY motto may appear subtly on books, signs, murals, ending titles and the journal.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: The city has history
entries.description: Small details should imply that the town existed before the player arrived; do not explain every mystery with exposition.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Wonder without glitter
entries.description: Calm, grounded, witty, inhabited; little magical moments are rare and earn their impact.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Shylo's identity
entries.description: Shylo is a gray/cream Norwegian Elkhound with pointed ears and a curled tail; ambient supporting companion, not the central mascot.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Fictional commerce
entries.description: The game does not sell, deliver, redeem or enable purchases of real-world cannabis.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: No financial promises
entries.description: Gameplay achievements, lore and Easter eggs do not promise real crypto, price appreciation or holder rewards.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Work in public
entries.description: Publish honest visual concepts, feature progress and changelogs without leaking puzzle answers or calling concepts finished gameplay.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Clear feature status
entries.description: User requests, concept art, assigned Replit work and actually verified playable functions are different evidence levels.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: No platform claims
entries.description: No Steam, Epic, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo or other distribution support can be claimed without a verified release plan/approval.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: GLP separation
entries.description: GreenLight Pay is unrelated to the fictional game economy and never presented as payment processing or token utility for this game.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: The first scene
entries.description: Wake in a modest room, notice a written task list, step into early morning, and survey a neglected growing space.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Emotional arc
entries.description: Player learns responsibility through failure, rebuilding, friendships, and incremental improvements—not fast-money fireworks.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Game identity shorthand
entries.description: From one rooftop (or modest plot) to a living city, with a long-term chapter of stewardship rather than an instant empire.

entries.section: 01 · Game identity, pillars and boundaries
entries.title: Final IP and game publisher structure
entries.description: Working title and design are set; trademark/rights, age ratings, official business ownership and platform agreements require separate verification.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: GameCube-era mood
entries.description: Muted stylized 3D inspired by original A Wonderful Life rather than bright mobile anime or modern high-saturation remake aesthetics.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Grounded colors
entries.description: Worn olive, hay, dirt brown, weathered timber, concrete, brick, washed blue, soft yellow daylight, restrained green.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: No pink-first city
entries.description: Avoid pink or lavender-dominated skies, giant cherry blossoms, pastel kawaii UI, glitter, neon everywhere.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: People look like residents
entries.description: Modestly proportioned original 3D characters, readable silhouettes, worn practical clothes, human expressions.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: UI serves the chores
entries.description: Real-time scene takes priority over menus; small tool/status HUD; only contextual dialogue and shop panels when needed.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: No poster-as-gameplay
entries.description: Splash artwork is not proof of a 3D world; screenshots should come from the actual game when called gameplay.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Originalized reference
entries.description: Use user-approved calmer concept board as guiding composition, with actual game props and work replacing decorative UI panels.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Third-person camera
entries.description: Slightly above-and-behind follow camera, gentle perspective, manual turn and restrained distance options.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Weathering and aging
entries.description: Wood chips, weather stains, dusty shelves, slightly crooked signs, used tools, creek stones, weeds between paving stones.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Interior lighting
entries.description: Greenhouse daylight and subtle magenta grow lights only where justified; softer shadows indoors.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Sky and clouds
entries.description: Blue-gray mornings, warm amber evenings, genuine dusk; cloud coverage changes by weather.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Plant silhouettes
entries.description: Obvious visual difference between small vegetative plants, flowering plants and harvest-ready crops.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Shopfront typography
entries.description: Painted shop signs and parchment-style tooltips; not huge hovering branded signs on every corner.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Journal graphics
entries.description: Handwritten notebook, worn paper tabs, pressed-leaf bookmarks and map annotation stickers.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Map design
entries.description: Hand-drawn village/district sketch with discovered locations; no false claims that all neighborhoods are unlocked.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Character portrait restraint
entries.description: Optional dialogue portraits, original design, no oversized chibi eyes.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Visible domesticity
entries.description: A sink, bed, dirty boots, calendar, kettle, hallway, shelf and meaningful storage.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Gentle animations
entries.description: Breathing, head turns, routine idle behavior, watering, sorting harvests, sweeping, opening storefronts.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: An imperfect town
entries.description: Trucks, billboards, fences, service alleys, little hill trails and quiet water rather than an amusement park.

entries.section: 02 · Visual direction, interface and presentation
entries.title: Visual reward cadence
entries.description: Big reveal for a building upgrade or first harvest; everything else subtle.

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
entries.title: Local buses and tram

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation
entries.title: Bicycle

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 03 · Districts, geography and transportation

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
entries.title: DJ Booth

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
entries.title: Mechanic's Shop

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
entries.title: Archive and Library
entries.description: Books, paper archives, local photographs, Chronicle excerpts, book lending.

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
entries.title: Warehouse
entries.description: Expansion from handmade work to larger operation, maintaining resource/time constraints.

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
entries.title: Cold Storage

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces
entries.title: Extra farm lots

entries.section: 04 · Buildings, shops and indoor spaces

sections.title: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Time matters
entries.description: Daily obligations, routines and changing locations should be meaningful—not merely a timer icon.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Four seasons
entries.description: Spring, summer, autumn, winter with distinct color, environment, market stock and schedule patterns.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Short seasons
entries.description: Candidate 10 game days per season during early testing; tunable for gameplay satisfaction.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Day progression
entries.description: Approx. 12–18 minutes per game day unless the player sleeps or enters a controlled time skip.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Sleep to advance
entries.description: Player enters bed and begins next morning; crop state, calendar, weather and NPC schedules update.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Morning ritual
entries.description: Check calendar, weather, plants and supplies before choosing route.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Shop hours
entries.description: Doors may be closed outside business hours; clock becomes meaningful.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: NPC commuting
entries.description: Shopkeepers open/close, eat, visit market and return home; route schedules persist by day.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Weather state
entries.description: Sun, cloud and rain; changes ambience, growth modifiers, water availability and schedule decisions.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Outdoor shelter
entries.description: Open plots and greenhouses respond differently to rain, wind and winter.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Temperature abstraction
entries.description: Simple season/environment suitability modifier, not a real-world cultivation instruction manual.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Player stamina
entries.description: Watering, cleaning and chores consume a manageable resource, restored by sleep or simple meals.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Reputation passage
entries.description: Residents remember years of events and completed chores.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Seasonal renovations
entries.description: Storefronts, town banners, market stalls and props change incrementally.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Birthdays
entries.description: NPC calendar birthdays provide small optional relationship moments.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Seasonal visitors
entries.description: Traveling vendor or archivist arrives on certain weeks.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Calendar journal
entries.description: Appointment, event, crop estimate and daily note page.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Rainy afternoon
entries.description: Slower streets, cover sounds, conversations that vary with weather.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Generational epilogue
entries.description: Long-running town changes could culminate in an epilogue rather than an infinite wealth grind.

entries.section: 05 · Life, time, seasons, weather and routines
entries.title: Weather emergencies
entries.description: Power outage or leaks as accessible fictional maintenance quests, with no unsafe real-world repair instructions.

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
entries.title: Hands-on care loop
entries.description: Approach actual 3D plot, ready tool, sow, water, inspect, wait, harvest and see consequences.

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
entries.title: Soil preparation

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
entries.title: Seeds as inventory

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
entries.title: Basic soil supplies

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics

entries.section: 06 · Virtual cultivation and genetics
